enchantment.ArchaeologistEnchantment.Hoe: Double chance for artifacts when digging up artifact spots.
enchantment.ArchaeologistEnchantment.Pan: More artifacts, bone fragments and artifact troves when panning.
enchantment.AutoHookEnchantment: Fish hook themselves, no need to click when they bite.
enchantment.BottomlessEnchantment: The watering can never runs dry.
enchantment.EfficientToolEnchantment: Using the tool costs no energy.
enchantment.FisherEnchantment: Panning sometimes brings up a fish as well.
enchantment.GenerousEnchantment.Hoe: Often gives an extra item when digging (artifact spots, clay, winter roots).
enchantment.GenerousEnchantment.Pan: Up to two extra finds per panning.
enchantment.MasterEnchantment: +1 Fishing level while you hold the rod.
enchantment.PowerfulEnchantment.Axe: Hits harder: trees and stumps take fewer swings.
enchantment.PowerfulEnchantment.Pickaxe: Hits harder: rocks and boulders take fewer swings.
enchantment.PreservingEnchantment: Bait and tackle are used up only half as often.
enchantment.ReachingToolEnchantment: One more charge level: up to 5×5 tiles at once.
enchantment.ReachingToolEnchantment.Pan: Reach panning spots from farther away.
enchantment.ShavingEnchantment: Chopping trees can drop wood with every swing, before the tree falls.
enchantment.ArtfulEnchantment: The special attack recharges twice as fast.
enchantment.BugKillerEnchantment: Double damage against bugs, flies, grubs, spiders and rock crabs.
enchantment.CrusaderEnchantment: +50% damage against ghosts, skeletons, mummies and shadow people. Mummies stay down.
enchantment.HaymakerEnchantment: Cutting weeds often gives extra fiber and hay (into your silo if there is room).
enchantment.MagicEnchantment: Each swing fires a small star shot.
enchantment.SlimeGathererEnchantment: Slimes drop extra slime when killed.
enchantment.VampiricEnchantment: Kills sometimes heal you (9% chance, about 10% of the monster's health).
config.expand-key.name: Details key
config.expand-key.tooltip: Hold this while hovering an enchanted tool or weapon to see what its enchantments do.
config.show-hint.name: Show hint
config.show-hint.tooltip: Show a small line in the tooltip reminding you of the key.
